description: Patch an assistant. Only supplied fields change; nested config blocks are upserted. voice_settings updates call greeting mode, opening messages, and voicemail behavior; platform_tools declaratively replaces the attached platform-catalog tools (an empty array detaches all — see the field description).

platform_tools.description: Platform tool names to attach, e.g. ["book_appointment", "send_email"]. Declarative within the platform catalog: tools in the list are attached, catalog tools missing from the list are detached, custom tools are never touched. Omit for no change; [] detaches all platform tools. See GET /v3/tools for the catalog; custom tools attach via POST /v3/tools/{id}/assign.

enable_voicemail_detection.description: Records intent only: persisted and returned on read, but voicemail detection is currently platform-managed and this flag does not yet gate runtime behavior.

greeting_mode.description: How the assistant opens a call: `dynamic` (AI-generated opener; default), `fixed` (speaks the configured opening message verbatim), or `contact_first` (stays silent until the contact speaks).

inbound_opening_message.description: Spoken opener for inbound calls. Only valid in `fixed` greeting mode. Template variables (e.g. a contact first-name placeholder) are allowed and resolve per call. `null` clears this direction.

outbound_opening_message.description: Spoken opener for outbound calls. Only valid in `fixed` greeting mode. Template variables are allowed and resolve per call. `null` clears this direction.

voicemail_message.description: Played when voicemail is detected, after which the assistant stops. Empty or `null` means the assistant hangs up on voicemail instead.

name: assistants_update
